name: Lizard IRL
noteEs: Lizard IRL es uno de los streamers más activos de Last Epoch con foco en hardcore, speedrun y ladder push. Member del Maxroll Team — sus builds y reglas de min-max han shaped el meta de SC y HC, especialmente en push de corruption. Cadencia de streams casi diaria durante season activa. Si vas a jugar HC o pushear seriamente, su channel es referencia obligatoria.
noteEn: Lizard IRL is one of the most active Last Epoch streamers with focus on hardcore, speedrun, and ladder push. Member of the Maxroll Team — his builds and min-max rules have shaped both SC and HC meta, especially in corruption push. Near-daily stream cadence during active season. If you'll play HC or push seriously, his channel is required reading.
highlightsEs: Maxroll Team member — sus builds aparecen integrados en maxroll.gg
Foco en hardcore push y speedrun, donde domina SC/HC ladders
Cadencia casi diaria de streams durante season activa
Theorycrafter respetado para min-max de defense layers
Content style direct y sin filler — útil para players intermedios/avanzados
